## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2015-02-11: S-1/A files the form-of Reorganization TRA template as Exhibit 10.5
- 2015-03-31: Up-C IPO closes; SLP Reorganization TRA executed between GoDaddy Inc. and SLP III Kingdom Feeder I, L.P.
- 2015-04-06: 8-K attaches the executed SLP Reorg TRA as Exhibit 10.8

#### Coordinated termination

- 2020-07-31: Standalone Termination and Release Agreement executed (8-K Exhibit 10.5); component of the $850M aggregate settlement across all five GoDaddy TRAs

## Explanation

The Silver Lake Reorganization TRA originated at GoDaddy's March 31, 2015 Up-C IPO and obligated the public company to pay 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits attributable to the pre-IPO basis step-ups and NOLs arising from the merger of SLP III Kingdom Feeder I, L.P. into GoDaddy Inc. The underlying tax-asset pool was fixed at the merger, so termination took the form of a standalone Termination and Release Agreement. It was settled jointly with the other four GoDaddy TRAs on July 31, 2020 for $850M aggregate. See `contract_log.md` for the full termination instrument set.
